name: Downgrade the Complete Edition to 1.0.8.0
description: Replaces the Complete Edition game files with the 1.0.8.0 build. The alternative to 1.0.7.0, and the one to pick for FusionFix and everything that installs through its overloader: on 1.0.7.0 FusionFix corrupts the heap and takes the game down about ten seconds in. What it costs is the rest of the 1.0.7.0 catalog - most mods in this scene target that version. Radio songs Rockstar removed from the Complete Edition do NOT come back here either.

sources.note: Game files for 1.0.8.0, 213 entries, from the same GitHub release as the 1.0.7.0 package. Checked rather than assumed: the GTAIV.exe inside (SHA-256 3d90e7c516fa450ca002e5031e62c0f66b404590f33e6cc9793b0da4fffbfd0f, 15628696 bytes) reports 1.0.8.0 in its own version resource, which is what the launcher and the trainer both read.
